paragraphs: The Discovery Td5 uses the Td5 — a 2.5-litre inline-five diesel, fitted from 1998 to 2004 across the D2 generation. It was the last of the classic Discovery diesel engines before the TDV6 era, and remains a popular choice among Land Rover enthusiasts. The Td5 is a completely different engine from the earlier 200Tdi/300Tdi units — electronic injection rather than mechanical, and a five-cylinder layout rather than four. Knowing which engine your Discovery has matters, which is why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Td5 engines for every Discovery Td5 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.5-litre inline-five diesel fitted to the Discovery from 1998 to 2004 (D2 generation). Known for injector harness oil contamination and crank sensor failure over time — see the callout above. We replace injector seals, timing chain components, and check the injector harness and crank sensor as standard on every Td5 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The Td5 is specific to the D2 generation Discovery, produced from 1998 to 2004. Fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming a Td5 part from a Defender is identical — risks a compatibility problem. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (Td5) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
